info.name: NCSMS API v1
info.description:
National Council of Sports Management System - Backend API and Website CMS.

Setup:
1. Set baseUrl. For the Docker preview use http://localhost:9080. For a direct backend use the backend origin.
2. Set loginEmail and loginPassword in collection variables. They are intentionally blank in this file.
3. Run Auth / Login. The test script saves accessToken and refreshToken.
4. Authenticated requests use the saved accessToken via Bearer auth.
5. CMS public read endpoints work without auth. Admin CMS endpoints require the correct role/permission.

Token lifecycle: access tokens are short-lived. Run Auth / Refresh Token when accessToken expires.
